# Recovery definition fixtures

These source sets reproduce the six active definition revisions recorded in recovery preparation #3917. They are copied from public Git history, with exact originating commits, file hashes, revision digests and runtime identity in `manifest.json`. The resident test compiles them through ordinary installation and requires the recorded digests; it does not rewrite registry identities.

The fixtures contain no live telemetry. All queued data is synthetic. They preserve older active definitions even where the bundles distributed with the deployed program had already moved on. Their use does not authorize installing or activating a definition on the live resident.
